## About
Denton European is an auto repair shop on E McKinney St in Denton. We specialize in Audi and Volkswagen, and we also work on Mercedes, BMW, Porsche, Fiat and Jaguar, plus cars and trucks from Chevy, Ford, Dodge, Toyota, Nissan and Honda.
If you're tired of dealership prices and long waits, bring your car here. We keep our prices reasonable, give you a realistic time to finish the job, and our mechanics are happy to explain what's wrong and what the repair involves.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 166 Google reviews. Call or stop by and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Audi repair and maintenance: Audi is our specialty, from routine service to bigger repairs.
- Volkswagen repair and maintenance: Service and repairs for Volkswagen at a price that makes sense.
- All European brands: We also work on Mercedes, BMW, Porsche, Fiat and Jaguar.
- Domestic cars and trucks: Repairs for domestic cars and trucks, too.
- Regular maintenance: Oil changes, brakes, fluid changes, timing belts and the rest of your regular maintenance.
- Warning light diagnostics: Light on in the dash? Bring it in and we'll find out what's going on.
- Pre purchase inspection: Thinking about buying a car near Denton? One out-of-town reviewer scheduled a pre purchase inspection with Matt before buying.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We specialize in Audi and Volkswagen, but we fix all makes and models of cars and trucks.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call or stop by and we'll give you a free estimate on your repair.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed on weekends.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: Give us a call at (940) 383-0600 and we'll get you on the schedule.
